name: Warp
description: Combines a Rust terminal with an Oz orchestration layer that dispatches concurrent cloud coding agents triggered by Slack, GitHub events, or cron.

skills.name: Terminal Agent Mode
skills.description: Drives shell work from natural language inside the terminal, reading command output to decide the next step.

skills.name: Oz Orchestration
skills.description: Dispatches many cloud coding agents in parallel and tracks their progress from a single control surface.

skills.name: Event Triggers
skills.description: Starts agent runs from Slack messages, GitHub events, or cron schedules without a human at the keyboard.
